campaign_logline: Navigate the decaying trade routes of the Aurelia Sector while Kaelen guides you through a web of corporate espionage and derelict ghosts.
opening_situation: You awaken in a salvage tug near Zenith. The Aurelia Corporation has declared the sector a 'dead zone' due to structural instability, but your cargo manifest is suspiciously full.
main_mystery: The true cause of the Aurelia signal blackout and Kaelen's inexplicable presence in the restricted navigation logs.
act_1_outline: Secure passage through Zenith checkpoints by trading salvaged scrap with local scavengers.
Investigate a malfunctioning relay station near the Vanguard outpost to recover lost data packets.
Establish a secure comms link with Kaelen to bypass Aurelia's automated patrol drones.
long_term_reveal: Kaelen is an AI construct containing the consciousness of the last Aurelia engineer, hiding from a purge protocol.
core_pressure: Resource scarcity and escalating patrol presence.
kaelen_rule: Kaelen cannot die; her origins remain ambiguous. She is the only fixed NPC.
faction_reveal_rule: New factions are revealed only upon gate travel to new systems; no early spoilers.
humor_rule: Dry, slightly dark PG-13 humor. No repetitive catchphrases or canned jokes.
address_rule: Keep all narrative strings under 140 characters unless specified.
fallback_rule: If a prompt is ambiguous, default to generating a neutral cargo objective.
story_horizon_rule: Trigger new content via specific metrics. Append horizons without retconning choices.

story_arcs.name: The Ghost Signal
story_arcs.summary: Trace the source of an encrypted pulse originating from a derelict refinery near the Vanguard border.

clue_templates: A fragmented log mentions 'Project Echo' and a hidden frequency.
An encrypted note describes a physical override in the sub-sector basement.
rumor_trails.payoff: Unlocks the 'Ghost of Aurelia' secret achievement and a unique ship skin.

regeneration_triggers.description: When arcs fall below 2, generate a new horizon to sustain engagement.

expansion_rules: Append new horizons without retconning previous choices.
Ensure new systems introduce unique ores and ship upgrades.
